d:
Bihar ka nitish setu sirph uttar aur dakshin bihar ko jorne vala pul nahin, balki iske rajnitik mayne bhi nikale ja rahe hain. pradhanmantri narendr modi 21 navanbar ko is chhah len pul ka udghatan karenge. is pul ke namakran ko bijepi aur jediyu ke rishton ke sandarbh men bhi dekha ja raha hai. kya nitish setu bihar men endie ke bhitar bijepi aur jediyu ki majbut sajhedari ka naya pratik banega?
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
